name: What does custom framing include during a home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What does custom framing include during a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom framing involves constructing non-standard interior architectural structural and partition walls to reshape your floor plan. Unlike basic modular framing, custom framing includes building basement room divisions, recessed wall niches, tray or coffered ceilings, walk-in closets, and structural openings for room additions. In residential remodeling, framing sets the plumb and level baseline for all subsequent drywall, trim carpentry, and tile installation. Because our crew handles carpentry directly on-site, we verify precise rough openings for custom doors, windows, and built-in fixtures before mechanical rough-ins begin, ensuring the framing matches your finish layout exactly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom framing involves building custom interior walls, soffits, basement partitions, and ceiling features to reshape your layout before drywall and finish work.
